scope: Initial broad-index institutional-calendar event study and broad-ETF activity observation research; no signal promotion or trading.

knowledge_cutoff.rule: Use one fixed cutoff per trading day, never earlier than market close. Inputs available later move to the next eligible cutoff.

targets.etf_universe: Only versioned broad-ETF pool membership backed by formal unitholder disclosure; membership starts no earlier than its conservative market-availability time.
targets.price_basis: Official index closing levels for indices. ETF returns require point-in-time corporate-action treatment; current backward-adjusted history must not be substituted. Missing qualified adjustment evidence removes the observation.

primary_endpoint.origin: t is the last completed close strictly before the prediction cutoff; labels use the next h complete trading sessions.
primary_endpoint.display_transform: sqrt(RV_h) may be displayed; values are not annualized and raw values are not compared across horizons.
primary_endpoint.missing_values: Any missing, non-finite or non-positive required price makes the label unavailable; never fill zero.
primary_endpoint.maturity: A label is usable only after all h sessions have completed and the exact input versions satisfy the relevant knowledge cutoff.

six_periods.design: Six-category contrasts and joint incremental test; there is no non-six-period control group.

discrete_events.design: Comparable non-event windows matched by weekday, month, market state and lagged volatility known at the prediction cutoff.
discrete_events.prohibited: No matching on future returns, future volatility, smoothed future state or post-event revisions.

controls.overlap: Retain multi-event markers; report mutually exclusive windows and single-event subsamples as sensitivity analyses.

purge.rule: Remove every training sample whose [t+1,t+h] label interval overlaps any validation or OOS label interval. Adjacent half-open intervals sharing only a boundary do not overlap.

embargo.unit: complete trading days on the applicable exchange calendar
embargo.rule: After each validation/OOS segment, exclude the next five complete eligible sessions before any later training sample may be used; actual interval purge still applies independently.

sample_gates.rule: Thresholds apply per target, event family and horizon; a failing target is not hidden by pooling stronger targets. No post-OOS threshold reduction.

multiple_testing.family: All six-period/category, event, horizon, target and preregistered subsample hypotheses in the same experiment family.
multiple_testing.new_trials: Append a new trial and cumulative family attempt count; do not rewrite the original family after seeing results.

oos_support.primary_rule: A preregistered OOS event contrast or joint calendar-increment test requires Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and all sample/coverage gates to pass.
oos_support.effect_reporting: Report effect size, dependence-appropriate confidence interval, fold results, raw and adjusted p values and coverage.
oos_support.promotion: oos_supported remains research-only and never creates a trading signal.

pool_coverage.below_full_gate: partial or unknown; never silently shrink the denominator
pool_coverage.scale_basis: Only lagged scale known at the prediction cutoff; unknown denominator means unknown coverage.

activity_thresholds.unknown: Missing baseline, invalid member coverage or unqualified inputs

share_quality.rule: At least 70% exactly unchanged shares triggers source/date/unit review. Without qualified confirmation, share-change estimation is blocked rather than interpreted as zero subscription/redemption.

etf_daily_core.attribution: actor_attribution=not_identifiable; historical unitholder evidence never identifies the current trader.
